economics.difference_from_v1_1: v1.1 retained full-universe group weights and put unselected weight in cash; this proposal equally weights and fully invests across selected groups
economics.reference_baseline: equal weight across every eligible ticker group in the same timing cohort
economics.selected_group_return: equal mean of saved gross split-adjusted endpoint returns across observations in selected ticker group
economics.selected_weights: equal weight across selected ticker groups, renormalized to 100%; this is a new proposal rule
economics.uninvested_cash: zero-return cash only when no group is selected; no implicit costs

metrics.aggregate: equal weight across the three folds with denominators disclosed
metrics.cohort_aggregation: equal weight across evaluable compatible timing cohorts within fold
metrics.primary: per-cohort selected equal-weight gross endpoint return minus full eligible-cohort equal-weight gross endpoint return
secondary: top-k positive-label precision where label semantics match
metrics.undefined: any blocked evidence yields explicit NOT_EVALUABLE for affected candidate/fold; no row dropping

positioning.prior_exposure: development results and zero-selection diagnostic already viewed

question: Do the saved ranking scores order the recorded development observations usefully when evaluated under an explicit cohort-relative selection rule?

supported: conditional ordinal-ranking description on exact saved development sample
gross split-adjusted endpoint economics under the proposed arithmetic rule

selection_contract.empty_cohort: retain with 100% cash and zero candidate gross return
selection_contract.identity_scope: ticker groups, not verified same-security identities
selection_contract.k_basis: existing frozen target_policy daily_top5 and producer label construction; no k search
selection_contract.missing_nonfinite: if any expected score, grouping field, return, or row mapping is missing/nonfinite, block that candidate/fold result; never silently exclude
selection_contract.old_threshold_0_60: not used by this new proposal and not described as erroneous
selection_contract.rejection_gates: apply saved abstained, risk_rejected, and rule_rejected flags before ranking; missing/null gate evidence blocks
selection_contract.ticker_group_score: arithmetic mean of every finite saved observation score in the ticker group; equal observation weight
